tests.description: Timed check on The Origins of the Universe

questions.question: Explain how the Big Bang theory can be compatible with religious belief.
questions.correctAnswer: Many Christians and Muslims accept the Big Bang as the scientific explanation for HOW the universe began, while believing that God/Allah was the cause behind it. The Catholic Church officially accepts the Big Bang, and the Qur'an's description of the universe being "split apart" (Surah 21:30) can be read as referencing the Big Bang.
